title: The normal defect of the annuli B_ρ∖B_σ converges to that of B_ρ as σ ↓ 0
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ : ℝ), Tendsto (fun σ : ℝ ↦ normalDefect V x (closedBall x ρ \ closedBall x σ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (normalDefect V x (closedBall x ρ)))
